Collect receipts for expense reimbursements
The poster used OpenClaw to gather receipts for several trip reimbursements, saving them quite some time.
·
Apr 1, 2026
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
The commenter used OpenClaw on Gensee’s free hosting and gave it access to their email. They had it search messages for trip-related receipts like conference registration, hotel, rideshare, and meals, then convert those receipts to PDFs and file them into the right folder; the post does not describe any manual step beyond using the organized receipts for reimbursement.
How it went
It handled receipts for several trip reimbursements and saved the commenter quite some time. The source gives no accuracy numbers or failure cases, only that it was especially helpful because they dislike doing reimbursements.
Worth knowing
They say they did it at 0 cost using Gensee’s free OpenClaw hosting.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
I took [number] trips for work between [start date] and [end date]. Search my email at [email account] and any folders I point you to for receipts from those trips, save each one into a folder named [trip name] with the date, vendor, and amount in the filename, and give me a spreadsheet totaling each trip. You're done when every trip has its receipts and a total, and you've flagged any that look missing. Don't submit anything to my employer's expense system; show me the finished package first.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/openclaw/comments/1sb1478/i_stopped_building_fancy_agent_setups_i_started
